items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Gains Wider Model Portfolio Distribution In Advisor Channel
items.summary: Orion is adding model portfolios from BlackRock (NYSE: BLK), Fidelity, and Vanguard to its Tailored Allocation Portfolios offering. The move allows advisors on Orion's platform to use BlackRock investment models within personalized, tax-aware portfolio solutions. The partnership broadens distribution for BlackRock's model portfolios in the advisory channel alongside other large asset managers. items.title: Jensen Huang Has Become World’s 8th Richest Person
items.summary: Jensen Huang turned a modest chip startup into the backbone of the global AI arms race, and his personal fortune now rivals the biggest names in tech. But three mounting challenges could test whether Nvidia's reign at the top is as unshakeable as it appears.
